description: This file defines the class `Theme` in the `Opencart \\Catalog \\Model \\Design` namespace. The class appears to retrieve theme configuration data for a specific route in an OpenCart-based application. It contains a method `getTheme` that queries the database for theme details associated with the current store and given route.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents the theme model for retrieving theme configuration data based on route and store ID.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves theme data from the database for the specified route, scoped to the current store ID.
